template_status: LIBERA proposed extraction schema based on public prospectus sections and paper workflows; not a verbatim published experimental template

source_identity.rule: Distinguish fund mandate, fund-manager commentary and house sector research. Do not assign house views to a specific fund without source support.

public_holdings_reference.role: observed allocation comparator, not a unique optimal strategy

evaluation_outputs.tool_information_boundary: Model-facing tools may use only evidence already received in the current run and submitted arguments. They cannot read evaluator-only annotations, hidden mandates or unrevealed constraints. Gold adherence checks occur offline, and their outputs must not be exposed during the run.
evaluation_outputs.note: A repaired allocation cannot establish that the AI's original proposal followed the mandate. Independent human annotation is pending; automated agent review does not complete that step.

source_basis.role: Official source-document structure; not an academic paper.
Investor profile and company-information separation, sections 3.1-3.3.
Natural-language mandates, typed constraints and separation of raw proposals from deterministic enforcement, sections 3.3 and 6.3.
